description: This file defines a mock class 'SessionServerAppMock' for the 'ISessionServerApp' interface, used for unit testing within the Rialto server manager component. It includes mock method declarations for various session server operations.

classes.name: SessionServerAppMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the ISessionServerApp interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Mocks the launch method of the session server application.

methods.name: isPreloaded
methods.description: Mocks the method to check if the session server is preloaded.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Mocks the configuration method for setting up the session server with app name, initial state, and app config.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Mocks the method to check if the session server is connected.

methods.name: getSessionManagementSocketName
methods.description: Mocks the method to retrieve the session management socket name.

methods.name: getSessionManagementSocketPermissions
methods.description: Mocks the method to retrieve permissions for the session management socket.

methods.name: getClientDisplayName
methods.description: Mocks the method to get the display name of the client.

methods.name: getInitialState
methods.description: Mocks the method to get the initial session server state.

methods.name: getServerId
methods.description: Mocks the method to get the server ID.

methods.name: getAppName
methods.description: Mocks the method to get the application name.

methods.name: getAppManagementSocketName
methods.description: Mocks the method to get the app management socket name.

methods.name: getMaxPlaybackSessions
methods.description: Mocks the method to get the maximum number of playback sessions.

methods.name: getMaxWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Mocks the method to get the maximum number of Web Audio players.

methods.name: cancelStartupTimer
methods.description: Mocks the method to cancel the startup timer.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Mocks the method to kill the session server.
